decision: Do not extend the stretching grid or accept this 24-parameter model. Diagnose the fixed torsional/angular baseline in a separately planned experiment.

coordinate_seeds.role: left silyl torsion with end symmetry explicitly checked

next_control.fitting_policy: No new amplitude or angular parameter fitted in J61. A later research model must propagate any angular equilibrium changes through every dependent term, pass Jacobian/curvature checks, and reserve new validation before fitting. Charges, pairs and torsion phase remain fixed.
next_control.projection: Project internal-coordinate Cartesian gradients against rigid and existing stretch directions, then check independent rank before orthonormalization. Retain full Cartesian responses.
next_control.protocol: Same PBE0/cc-pV(5+d)Z protocol and frozen settings as J61.
next_control.scientific_question: Can total angular/torsional response explain the stationary force outside stretching and distinguish fixed n=3 main-torsion-amplitude mismatch from angular equilibrium/stiffness mismatch?
next_control.two_step_policy: Central differences at two predeclared normalized displacement amplitudes for four independent directions. Freeze amplitudes and curvature/noise gates in a new execution plan before any call; this report does not launch that campaign.

smallest_methyl_specific_dependency.interior_dependency: Capped DP2 interior sio(osi,osi,c3,c3) and distinct end environments require separate targets after HMDS. Neither environment is constrained by Si-H coefficients.
smallest_methyl_specific_dependency.query_scope: The nine-atom control touches four directed Si-H queries. Fifteen methyl-domain queries remain separate; none receive J61 trial values.
smallest_methyl_specific_dependency.required_before_methyl_fit: Independently bound typing and unnormalized source charges; method-specific Si-C/C-H stationary and total-curvature baseline constraints plus separate methyl/Si-O torsional responses.

training_evidence.interpretation: Coordinate projections do not assign a physical cause. Unit-probe fractions overlap and are not additive. The main-torsion-amplitude probe motivates testing a fixed baseline; it does not prove a wrong source row or authorize a phase change.
